Knowledge facts: part C holds 35 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 9 to 11; part C2 holds 11 confusable blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer, the September 2026 revision line and the written-test requirement; question count, passing standard, format and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- AZ-INS-A-COUNT — written-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-INS-A-PASS — passing standard not printed; nothing shown to learners (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-INS-A-FORMAT — item format not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-INS-A-TIME — time limit not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-INS-A-EDITION — issuer current-edition confirmation pending; issuer page was bot-challenged at intake (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-INS-E-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- AZ-INS-ETWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: voter-registration contact numbers, donor sign-up channels and online service names (for example sec02-F12, sec02-F28, sec02-F32) can change and must be refreshed from official pages; the insurance minimums change only by statute.
Index: exam authority in A; audience in B; knowledge facts with misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines in C; confusables in C2; accuracy in D; market in E and E2; definition-of-done matrix in G.
